summary: A member's offer to welcome other newcomers can lead to an executive board seat.
realLife: A new 31st District member volunteered to chair membership, another officer described his qualifications and the membership approved him for the role and the executive board.
inGame: needs: volunteer, open role and required vote.

turns.pulledBy: The nominee accepts the board duties as well.
turns.what: The members vote on the appointment.
turns.writesBack: The new chair joins the executive board.

turns.pulledBy: The volunteer can help with welcomes but cannot attend board meetings.
turns.what: The chair separates the volunteer task from the office.
turns.writesBack: The board seat still needs a nominee.
